summary: Reproduced the breakable DSA decode None-metadata page-table failure on the assigned ROCm GPU using the checked-out Indexer.forward_cuda path, then fixed metadata resolution to match the decode graph lifecycle. TC piecewise retains its custom-op metadata handoff, while breakable decode now uses the capture-stable metadata initialized by DecodeCudaGraphRunner and alternate attention backends that return no DSA metadata still return cleanly.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, the real Indexer.forward_cuda breakable-decode control flow passed metadata=None to the paged path and raised AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get_page_table_64'. Raw output: /job/logs/j-d2a938f36ff3/failing_before_breakable_metadata.log

Two ROCm GPU regressions passed: breakable decode resolves a valid DSA page-table metadata object, and an alternate backend returning no indexer metadata remains a clean no-op. Raw output: /job/logs/j-d2a938f36ff3/regression_after.log

10 tests and 4 subtests passed on gfx950. Decode/prefill page-table transforms, nontrivial strides, large batches and context lengths, mixed lengths, padding, empty batches, and the get_page_table_64 interface were checked against independent PyTorch references. Raw output: /job/logs/j-d2a938f36ff3/gpu_page_table_tests.log

Disassembled the gfx950 Triton HSACO produced by the GPU test. The transform_index_page_table_decode_kernel symbol contains real AMDGPU buffer_load_dword and buffer_store_dword instructions. Raw output: /job/logs/j-d2a938f36ff3/decode_page_table_isa.txt; compiler artifacts: /job/artifacts/j-d2a938f36ff3/triton-cache

remaining_limitations: The reported zai-org/GLM-5.3 configuration is a 753B FP8 model requiring TP4/PP2 across eight MI300X GPUs. This job had one MI355X and no model weights, so the full launch-to-serving condition was not reproduced.
The source report was on gfx942/MI300X with Torch 2.9.1; focused validation here used the prepared Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 environment on gfx950/MI355X.
No FlyDSL C++ or other native source changed, so no native rebuild was required.
